title: jaltomata procumbens
intro: Jaltomata procumbens, commonly known as the creeping jaltomata or creeping jaltomate, is a type of flowering plant in the nightshade family (Solanaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Jaltomata procumbens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds. Research has identified scopolamine and other tropane alkaloids as the primary bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties, although more studies are needed to fully understand its effects.
